name: website-contacts-mcp
display_name: Website Contacts & Socials (role emails, WhatsApp, LINE, Telegram)
description: Company contact channels from a website: role emails, WhatsApp, LINE, Telegram, social profiles. No personal data.
long_description: Give it a company website and get its published contact channels: role email addresses on the site's own domain (info@, sales@, reservations@), business phone lines from tel: and WhatsApp links (E.164), WhatsApp, LINE and Telegram links, and the company's Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok. Personal mailboxes, free-mail addresses and people's names are never returned. robots.txt is obeyed, pages are read one by one with a pause, blocked sites are reported and never bypassed. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_website_contacts
tools.description: Company contact channels published on a website: role emails, phones from tel:/WhatsApp links, WhatsApp, LINE, Telegram and company social profiles.

tools.name: get_websites_contacts
tools.description: The same contact card for up to 10 websites at once.
